custody_model: Custodial exchange-hosted staking. Bitstamp's launch material describes staking assets already held in a Bitstamp account while Bitstamp handles the technical staking process. Current first-party educational material states that customers maintain full ownership of crypto assets when staking with Bitstamp Earn. CYA preserves that product statement without treating it as proof of legal segregation or insolvency protection across every Bitstamp entity and jurisdiction.
yield_source: Proof-of-stake protocol rewards generated by supported assets. Current first-party material states that Bitstamp acts as service provider and charges a 15% commission on rewards received from the underlying protocol.
risk_notes: Risks include validator and protocol performance, slashing, network-specific lock-up or unstaking conditions, reward variability, market volatility, platform/custody exposure, jurisdiction-specific availability and regulatory change. Express customer-ownership language is not a universal principal or insolvency guarantee.
